subject: Follow-the-sun demo rotation — EU DPO + APAC security lead availability
body:
From: Alice Hsieh <alice.hsieh@medsupply.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating follow-the-sun demo windows for Dedicated (MedSupply)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick responses earlier. We need to lock a recurring demo cadence for our Dedicated + Private evaluation. Key constraints:
- We have stakeholders in SF (US), Berlin (EU DPO), and Singapore (APAC sec lead).
- MedSupply prefers small windows that rotate so each region can attend at reasonable hours; also DST shifts in EU may complicate things.

Can we propose a rotating schedule or templates for slots (e.g., week A: 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CET / week B: 09:00 PDT / 00:00 SGT)? Also need to confirm security reviewers' availability for the longer deep-dive (30–45 min) on the Dedicated network/config and data-handling.

Attaching our internal timeline (referenced). Primary contacts here: Tom Rivera (platform lead) and me.

Thanks,
Alice Hsieh
Program Manager, MedSupply Inc
alice.hsieh@medsupply.com

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alice Hsieh <alice.hsieh@medsupply.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating follow-the-sun demo windows for Dedicated (MedSupply)

Thanks Alice — looping in Laura (EU DPO) and Vivek (APAC sec lead) to get firm availability. Couple of thoughts up front:

- We can offer a rotating 30-minute "sprint" demo + 30-minute security Q&A cadence. Total 60 minutes for the deep-dive sessions that require both the EU DPO and APAC reviewer.
- To handle DST transitions, we maintain two templates and a simple rotation policy: Template A for Standard Time and Template B for DST overlap weeks.
- I'll propose specific slot times below for the next three weeks and ask Laura/Vivek to mark conflicts.

Proposed slots (all recurring weekly; rotation: Week 1=Slot 1, Week 2=Slot 2, repeat):
A) Slot 1: 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 SGT (tight for APAC but workable on alternating weeks)
B) Slot 2: 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CEST / 03:00 SGT (better for APAC on their morning)
C) Slot 3: 13:00 PDT / 22:00 CEST / 05:00 SGT (only for emergency deep dives)

Laura / Vivek — can you flag which of A/B you can commit to for May, and note any blackout dates (travel, holidays)? If none, I will send a calendar invite with the rotating ICS and the security checklist attached. Tom/Alice — does MedSupply prefer Slot A/B as the default?

-Karthik
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Hsieh <alice.hsieh@medsupply.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating follow-the-sun demo windows for Dedicated (MedSupply)

Karthik / Alice — quick availability note from the EU DPO side:

- I can commit to Slot A for May (08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST) on Tuesdays and Thursdays, except: 2027-05-10 and 2027-05-17 (travel).
- For the DST transition in late October/early November, I recommend we switch to Template B for four weeks to avoid repeated midnight calls for APAC reviewers.

I'll review the security checklist and add redlines, but this schedule looks sensible. If MedSupply prefers an APAC-friendlier time as the default, I can be flexible to accommodate one of the evening slots twice a month.

Laura Bennett
EU Data Protection Officer (acting)
Redwood Inference

---

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Hsieh <alice.hsieh@medsupply.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@medsupply.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:30:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating follow-the-sun demo windows for Dedicated (MedSupply)

Thanks — here's APAC constraints from my side:

- I can attend Slot B (11:00 PDT / 20:00 CEST / 03:00 SGT) but only as an alternate; nights are tough multiple times a week.
- Best pattern for APAC: one evening slot per month (rotate weeks) + one early morning APAC-friendly meeting if needed.
- Blocked dates: 2027-05-04 through 2027-05-06 (on-call) and 2027-05-25 (public holiday).

Proposal: default rotation to Slot A (EU-friendly) with a monthly Slot B session scheduled in advance and visible to all. That keeps burden spread across regions and aligns with Redwood's "follow-the-sun" support pattern.

I'll approve the security checklist after a quick pass; please attach the final one and the ICS invite.

-Vivek Kulkarni
APAC Security Lead
Redwood Inference

---

Next steps (from Karthik):
- I will prepare two calendar templates (Standard / DST-aware) and share an ICS with the rotating policy.
- Attach the security-review-checklist.pdf and the ICS; schedule recurring invites starting week of 2027-05-03.
- MedSupply: confirm preference for Slot A as the default; if you prefer APAC-leaning default, flag now.

Attachments referenced (stubs):
- demo-rotation-calendar-v1.ics (rotating recurrence + notes)
- security-review-checklist.pdf (30-point checklist for Dedicated/Private deep-dive)
notes: Calendar rotation template discussed; EU DPO (Laura) and APAC lead (Vivek) provided availability and blackout dates. MedSupply to confirm default preference.
